name: Gengo Translator
description: TMGMT translator plugin for the Gengo (formerly myGengo) crowd-sourced human translation service.
project_description:
Gengo translator plugin for the Translation Management Tools (TMGMT) project. Allows to submit translation jobs to Gengo .

 Features 
 
 Submit translation jobs to Gengo 
 Select the translation quality (Machine translation, Standard, Pro) 
 Get immediate feedback about the required credits and word count 
 Ability to request revisions of single texts out of a larger job 
 Interact with translator using a comments thread 
 
 The project of course also supports implicity all the features which are provided by TMGMT like a feature-rich review process, being able to translate different sources and more.

 Requirements 
 Depends on Translation Management Tools . Registration on http://www.gengo.com required to use this module.

 Credits 
 Initial development happened during a development sprint organized by Drupal Events in Zurich in January 2012 with more than 20 participants . See http://drupalevents.ch/drupal/codesprint-2012 for more information.

 This is the official integration module for Gengo, maintained in partnership by MD Systems . (Gengo was former named "MyGengo" and has been renamed in 2012.)
